about: The polish cases of two fixes of 2026-11-16, in the shape of polish.json: a set's plugin that Mutagen refuses is left out with a note, and a GUID in the form Wwise and xEdit show. In a file of their own so that other fixes' cases don't collide with them.

cases.title: query2 over @loaded answers when the load order holds a plugin Mutagen refuses: the plugin is left out and the notes say so
cases.before: query2 @loaded "SELECT count(*) FROM Weapon;" answered "Error: MissionsGalore.esm can't be read: Mutagen refuses it" (its records share FormKeys, C204), where @winners left the plugin out. A set left out a plugin with a read error or a missing master, but not a refused one.

params.sql: SELECT count(*) AS Weapons FROM Weapon;

pass_if.name: a count, no error, and the refused plugin named as left out of the set

all.matches: MissionsGalore\.esm: Mutagen refuses it[^\n]*It was left out of @loaded

cases.title: a sound reference's GUID in the form Wwise and xEdit show: first on the card, and by wwise() in query2 (Mutagen register C5)
cases.before: Eon's equip sound read 836f4d41-ec16-59a5-d734-f9911bfcd7a2, the same 16 bytes as .NET prints them; xEdit and Wwise show {59A5EC16-836F-4D41-A2D7-FC1B91F934D7} (Play_WPN_Pistol_Eon_Equip_Up), so a GUID taken from SFSearch didn't find the event. Held to xEdit by the user on Eon, Cutter and Grendel, six of six.

params.sql: SELECT EditorID, Equip_StartEvent, wwise(Equip_StartEvent) AS Wwise FROM Weapon WHERE EditorID IN ('Eon','Cutter','Grendel') ORDER BY EditorID;

pass_if.name: the card gives the Wwise form with Mutagen's beside it, and wwise() gives xEdit's GUID for each of the three weapons while the column keeps Mutagen's
